name: Design Lounge
license: Free to use in products. Credit appreciated. Do not republish as a catalogue.
readme: Read this first. Then open only what you lock: starts/<id>.json for the recipe, themes/<id>.css, pairings/<id>.css, and briefs/<id>.md for each piece. Search pieces.txt for pieces. Do not read index.json; it is the whole catalogue for tools.

kinds.title: A public website
kinds.blurb: Marketing, studio, or company site. Heroes, proof, a footer that signs off.
kinds.when: People arrive from the outside. The first viewport has to hold them.

kinds.title: A product or service
kinds.blurb: SaaS, a tool, a service with a price. Data when it earns the screen.
kinds.when: Someone is deciding whether to use you. Clarity over theatre.

kinds.title: A company platform
kinds.blurb: The thing staff live in: ops, admin, a dense home. Density without noise.
kinds.when: People open this every morning. Taste has to survive eight hours.

kinds.title: A personal app
kinds.blurb: One person’s money, health, or home. Not a staff tool, and not a marketing site.
kinds.when: The person using it is the customer. The number on the screen is theirs.

families.name: Quiet
families.mood: Hairlines, 6px corners, one solid button. The safe default for products that have to last.
rules: Radius 6px on controls, 8px on cards. Never more.
One solid primary. Secondary is outline, same height (40px web / 44px phone).
Hairline borders at 1px. No drop shadows on tables.
Focus ring 2px accent, 3px offset.

families.name: Soft
families.mood: Tonal fills, 14px corners, pills. Friendly without becoming a toy.
rules: Radius 14px on cards, 999px on chips and the primary button.
Primary is a soft accent wash, not a hard fill, unless contrast needs it.
Plenty of air: 24px gaps, 20px card pad.
Phone targets 44px. No hairlines thinner than 1px.

families.name: Sharp
families.mood: Zero radius, visible grid, type that does the work. Swiss without the poster shout.
rules: Radius 0 everywhere. If you round a button you have left the family.
1px ink rules. No shadows. Alignment is the decoration.
Primary can be a solid ink block; hover inverts.
Uppercase 11px labels, 0.12em tracking, on data and nav.

families.name: Editorial
families.mood: Paper, measure, a serif that holds a room. Buttons stay quiet so the type can speak.
rules: Measure 58–66ch on reading. Headlines can break the grid.
Buttons are outlined, 40px, no fill until hover.
Paper grain or warm off-white is allowed; stock photos are not.
Italic is a voice, used once per viewport.

families.name: Glass
families.mood: Translucent bars, 16px corners, things that float. Native feel on the web.
rules: Bars use backdrop-filter: blur(16px) at ~72% opacity. Always give a solid fallback.
Radius 16px on sheets, 999px on tab pills.
Phone chrome: 44px tab bar, home indicator clearance 10px.
Do not glass a whole page. One floating layer is enough.

families.name: Industrial
families.mood: Utility first. Tight type, 2px corners, labels that read like a yard sheet.
rules: Radius 2px. Dense padding (12px). Tables are first-class.
Primary is a committed fill (accent or ink). 36px on web, 44px on phone.
Mono for numbers. Tabular nums. No ornament.
Status colour is reserved for live state, never decoration.

pairings.mood: Bitmap caps over a mono body. Insert coin.
pairings.caution: Body text is Space Mono on purpose. Keep it for the game. Do not use this pairing for reports or long prose.

pairings.name: HUD
pairings.mood: Angular, technical, cockpit-adjacent. Pairs with cut corners and scanlines.
pairings.caution: Body text is Share Tech Mono on purpose. Cockpit and status screens only. Do not use it for reports.

pairings.name: Candy Clay
pairings.mood: Puffy, round, delighted. Built for chunky buttons.

pairings.name: Friendly SaaS
pairings.mood: Modern product sans with a mono for numbers and keys.

pairings.name: Devanagari
pairings.mood: A Nepali display serif for headings and amounts. Mukta for the interface. The currency word and the digits share one face.
pairings.caution: IBM Plex Mono is for Latin codes only. An amount that contains रु, रू, or Devanagari digits is set entirely in Noto Serif Devanagari or Mukta, digits included. Do not let the currency word fall back to another face. Group Nepal and India digits by lakh: 1,24,000.
